note: Lawn RV sites beside a playground and above-ground pool on VT 100 in Westfield, near Jay Peak; about ten tent sites sit along Taft Brook, where guests pan for gold. Recreation hall; Wi-Fi. --Claude
summary: Operator site (200): rates now W/E $50, W/E/S $55, tent $30 (stored note said $44/$48) - at, not over, the $50 gate; Passport America member ($24 W/E). Season May 1-Oct 15 confirmed. Phone/form booking. Google 4.8 (39), RV Life 4.5 ($$, 38 sites). Not waterfront confirmed (RV sites on open lawn; only tent sites on Taft Brook). Leaf-off imagery shows ~20 trailers on pads - possibly about half seasonal; no seasonal wording on the site. Keep.
flags: PRICE GATE: cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome fits is water/electric at $50 a night (operator rate page, undated, read 2026-11-16) - exactly $50, not over; passes without an exception. Passport America $24.
